title: Zoo Scene 9 — Water, Shade and Rest
purpose: Support simple inference, action talk and needs-based language using a calm zoo landscape.

sentenceModels: The elephant is near the water.
The lion is resting in the shade.
The penguin is by the pool.
The monkey is on the branch.

adultSupport.focus: Use the scene for talking about heat, water, rest and which places animals might like.
starterPrompts: Which animals are near the water?
Why might an animal go near the water?
expansionPrompts: Tell me which animals might want shade and which might want water.
First point to an animal near the pool, then point to an animal in the shade.

visualAudit: Reviewed in Wave 3 Batch 3 automatic pass against the main teaching targets.
